note:
REOPENED AFTER QUALITY REVIEW 2026-08-29. The previous closure proved six visually distinct reference-driven town districts in WorldbuildingGalleryShowcase and added many reusable facade/detail primitives, but it does NOT yet satisfy the intended reusable-town-authoring architecture. A seventh town cannot currently be authored as data/composition over reusable capabilities: adding a new style requires modifying the closed WorldBuilderTownArchitectureIds constants, TownArchitectureSilhouette/RoofForm/OpeningStyle enums and one-to-one FormMatchesSilhouette switch, the WorldBuilderTownArchitecture Resolve/CanonicalSeed switches, the WorldBuilderTownArchitectureVoxelAuthoring silhouette switch, and normally adding another bespoke Author<Town> method. That is a serious extensibility gap. The goal is a reusable town-generation system in which future towns can be created by defining a style/program/palette/role and composition recipe from shared architectural assemblies, without editing central backend dispatch for every new town.

PRESERVE THE ACCEPTED BASELINE: keep the six existing reference-driven styles and their visual identities: Kentridge pastoral timber-frame, Hightown vertical civic stone, Moordell low weathered moorland stone, Rossdam fortified/royal, Fairy Village organic/treehouse, and Orc Village heavy tribal/stockade. Preserve the existing shared 10-30 cm facade/detail vocabulary, material roles, deterministic behavior, required residential/commercial/civic/landmark roles, Rossdam fortification primitives, and built-gallery evidence path. Do not regress the distinct rendered forms already demonstrated.

REUSABILITY REQUIREMENT: separate style data from realization strategy. A town program must be able to compose reusable massing, roof, opening, facade, support, fortification/organic/stockade, prop and detail assemblies through public/shared WorldBuilder concepts. Adding an ordinary new town style that combines existing capabilities must not require adding a new enum member or case to a central switch and must not require a new town-named backend method. New backend code is acceptable only when the new town genuinely needs a new reusable architectural capability, and that capability must then become available to other towns. Prefer registries/specs/composable strategy data over name-based dispatch.

PROOF BY SEVENTH TOWN: add a test-only or showcase-visible seventh synthetic town style whose identity is a novel combination of existing reusable capabilities (for example a river-trade town mixing stone lower stories, timber upper framing, steep roofs, balconies/awnings, civic arch vocabulary and a distinct palette). It must be registered/authored through the same public path without editing a central list/switch specifically for that town and without an AuthorSyntheticTown-style method. The proof town must produce all four required structure roles, deterministic variation from seed, its chosen materials/forms/details, and a physically distinct result. It does not need Mounting Force reference fidelity because its purpose is architectural extensibility.

VISUAL QUALITY REVIEW: the six towns are recognizably distinct in the final 18-frame audit, which is a valid baseline. However, close views remain somewhat blocky/template-like in places, so the reopened work must not make visual quality worse or collapse styles into recolors. Re-run wide/player/close built-player evidence for the six production styles plus the seventh proof style and inspect it directly.

ACCEPTANCE: (1) existing six town styles remain visibly distinct and continue to satisfy their original material/form/detail/role contracts; (2) town style definitions are not limited to the six named IDs and are not coupled one-to-one to fixed silhouette/roof/opening enum combinations; (3) ordinary new styles can be supplied/registered as data/composition without modifying central Resolve, seed, form-compatibility, or voxel-authoring switches; (4) production realization is assembled from reusable generic architectural capabilities rather than one Author<Town> method per style; (5) the seventh proof town uses only existing reusable capabilities and requires no town-named backend implementation; (6) focused regressions prove registry/extensibility, deterministic seeded variation, four required roles, material/detail/form composition, and preservation of all six existing styles; (7) exact built WorldbuildingGalleryShowcase evidence renders the six baseline towns and the proof town without startup/runtime exceptions and confirms distinctness at wide/player/close range; (8) no direct scene voxel-writing or showcase-only geometry is introduced; and (9) blast radius and generation/render/memory cost remain within existing budgets.

The original closed implementation at fix commit c61f69d40ec7dfbdfb47cfa9f7c6e350a83e0001 is the accepted baseline, not work to discard.
resolutionSummary: Refactored town architecture to registry-driven style data and reusable role composition instead of six-name central dispatch, preserved all six accepted production identities, and added a seventh River Trade proof style composed only from existing architectural capabilities. Exact focused CI and built WorldbuildingGalleryShowcase validation passed with 21/21 wide/player/close audit frames, zero runtime exceptions/assertion failures, and authoring cost within the existing write budget.
